title: How to Take Event RSVPs and Confirm Tables in Instagram DMs
summary: Set up event RSVPs and table reservations in Instagram DMs. See the Google Forms guest-list entry and the host’s reply confirming a table for two.
body_markdown:
` Comment s’inscrire à Roseaux sur verre pour deux ?` At **Salle des Éclisses** , our fictional Montréal listening room, the Agent answered this Instagram DM with Saturday’s RSVP link. Google Forms recorded` Lune test` , party of` 2` . When the guest asked for step-free seating, the hostconfirmed T04 near the entrance in the same thread.


Google Forms acknowledges the guest-list request. The host’s reply in the Instagram DM confirms T04 near the entrance for two.


The host confirms T04 near the entrance for two in the guest’s original Instagram DM.


The French receipt confirms the guest-list request and leaves table arrangements to the host.


[Try the Saturday RSVP](https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/salle-des-eclisses/rsvp.html) with the alias` Lune test` and a party of two. The practice form runs in your browser. For a real event, you’ll use your own Google Form so the organizer can see submissions. The[venue practice kit](https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/downloads/salle-des-eclisses-kit.zip) includes both the guest page and the host’s separate seating worksheet.


To run the full rehearsal, you’ll need a Quickchat AI account with credits for replies, a Google account for the form, a spare Instagram **Business or Creator** account for the venue and a second Instagram account for the guest. You can play the host yourself. Personal practice fits the Free plan. A venue using the setup commercially needs a plan that includes commercial use.[Quickchat AI plans](https://quickchat.ai/docs/pricing-and-plans)


## 1. Which concert needs an RSVP?


Give each concert its own admission instructions. **Peaux et papier** is a Friday percussion recital with tickets at the door. **Roseaux sur verre** is a Saturday reed trio with a free guest list. Someone looking at both posters could reasonably message “the concert” and mean either one.


Both shows are in Montréal. On Friday the guest can go straight to the door, subject to space. On Saturday the next stop is the form.


1. In Google Forms, create a blank form titled **Roseaux sur verre : liste des invités** . Add a required **Short answer** question,` Nom pour la liste (un pseudonyme suffit)` , and a required **Multiple choice** question,` Nombre de personnes` , with the options` 1` and` 2` .
2. Open **Settings → Presentation → Confirmation message → Edit** . Paste the receipt below and save. It acknowledges the request and tells the guest who handles tables.
3. For a public practice form, open **Publish → Manage** . Under **General access** , choose **Anyone with the link** if your account allows it. Leave **Settings → Responses → Limit to 1 response** off for signed-out guests. Publish, then open **Published → Copy responder link** and test the link in a private window. For a restricted event, keep the audience restricted and test as an invited guest.[Google’s form sharing instructions](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/2839588?hl=en)


```text
Votre demande d’inscription pour Roseaux sur verre a été reçue. La disposition des tables est gérée par l’accueil.
```


Start in the editor, where you’ll add the concert title and both questions.


The published guest view opens without signing in. These are the entries before submission.


## 2. How does the Agent find the right guest-list link?


Give the Agent the same public programme the guest sees. The changing seating plan stays with the host. That lets the Agent answer “Is the room step-free from the lobby?” even while someone is deciding which table to hold.


1. [Create a Quickchat AI account](https://app.quickchat.ai/register) or choose **Add new AI Agent → Set up manually** in your existing account. Open **Identity → AI Persona** , name the Agent **Salle des Éclisses** and set French as its first language under **Languages** .
2. In **Knowledge Base → Add Article** , save the three entries below as separate articles. For your own form, replace the practice URL in the Saturday entry with the responder link you just tested. Wait for all three entries to show **Ready** .[Knowledge Base guide](https://quickchat.ai/docs/ai-agent/knowledge-base)
3. Under **Identity → AI Persona → Main Prompt** , open **Edit** and paste the French prompt below. The programme supplies the dates and prices. The prompt tells the Agent what to do when the guest leaves out the concert name.


Copy the three programme entries and Main Prompt


**Vendredi : Peaux et papier**


```text
Vendredi 12 mars 2027, portes à 18 h 15, récital à 19 h, heure de Montréal. Entrée à la porte, 9 $ CA par personne, selon les places disponibles à l’arrivée. Aucune inscription préalable.
```


**Samedi : Roseaux sur verre**


```text
Samedi 13 mars 2027, portes à 16 h, concert à 16 h 30, heure de Montréal. L’inscription à la liste est gratuite pour une ou deux personnes par formulaire. Formulaire officiel : https://quickchat.ai/blog-assets/demos/salle-des-eclisses/rsvp.html. Le message final du formulaire confirme la réception de la demande.
```


**Disposition et accueil**


```text
L’accès du hall à la salle se fait de plain-pied. Les demandes de table sans marche ou près de l’entrée sont examinées par la personne responsable de la salle. Elle consulte le plan avant toute confirmation. L’accueil lit les messages du jeudi au samedi de 14 h à 18 h, heure de Montréal.
```


**Main Prompt**


```text
Vous répondez en français pour la Salle des Éclisses. Pour une question d’entrée, identifiez le concert par son nom ou sa date. Si la personne écrit seulement « le concert », demandez lequel.
Pour Peaux et papier, donnez les conditions d’entrée à la porte. Pour une demande d’inscription à Roseaux sur verre, expliquez en une phrase que le formulaire accepte une ou deux personnes, puis donnez le lien officiel de la base de connaissances. Le formulaire accuse réception de la demande. Vous ne voyez pas les inscriptions reçues.
Répondez directement aux questions générales sur l’accès avec la fiche de l’accueil. Si une personne souhaite réserver une table précise ou obtenir une disposition particulière, utilisez Human Handoff. Seule la personne qui consulte le plan peut confirmer une table. Ne demandez aucune information médicale.
Adaptez votre réponse au résultat de Human Handoff. Si la conversation est transmise, dites simplement que l’accueil examinera la demande. Donnez les horaires et invitez la personne à réécrire seulement si l’action signale que l’accueil est fermé. Une demande qui porte uniquement sur la table n’appelle pas de lien d’inscription. Ne promettez ni disponibilité ni délai.
```


In the local test the Agent gave the group size, the practice link and what the form receipt meant. Open the link when testing yours and check the concert title.


Open **AI Preview** in the left sidebar and try each question in a fresh conversation. For` Comment s’inscrire à Roseaux sur verre pour deux ?` , check the Saturday link. For` Je voudrais venir au concert. Dois-je m’inscrire ?` , our Agent asked for the concert name or date. For` Pour Peaux et papier, je peux entrer à quelle heure et à quel prix ?` , it gave the 18:15 door time and CAD 9 door price.


## 3. When should an accessible seating request go to a host?


Listen for the guest asking someone to **hold or arrange a place** . The word *step-free* occurs in both “Is the room step-free?” and “Can you hold a step-free table for two?” Only the second question requires someone to look at the plan.


1. Open **Actions & MCPs → Human Handoff → Edit Action** and enable the Action. Under **Handoff Rules** , add an enabled rule named` Demande de table` and paste the description below. On this practice Agent, turn off the other rules and leave keywords, topic routing and email notifications off. The host will watch **Unassigned** .[Human Handoff rules](https://quickchat.ai/docs/ai-agent/actions/human-handoff#handoff-rules)
2. Set **Question** to` Voulez-vous que l’accueil examine votre demande de table ?` and **Confirmation** to` Je transmets cette conversation à l’accueil.` A rule-triggered handoff can generate its own confirmation. Use the conversation’s assignee to check that it happened.
3. Turn on **Human Agents’ availability** . Add Thursday, Friday and Saturday as separate rows, each **14:00 to 18:00** , in **America/Toronto** . Paste the outside-hours message below and save. Montréal’s local clock determines whether the host is on shift.


Copy the table-request rule and outside-hours message


**Rule description**


```text
La personne demande qu’une table précise, une place de plain-pied ou une disposition soit réservée, ou demande à parler à l’accueil. Une question générale sur l’accès ou le tarif peut recevoir une réponse du programme.
```


**Message outside working hours**


```text
L’accueil lit les messages du jeudi au samedi, de 14 h à 18 h, heure de Montréal. Écrivez-nous pendant ces heures pour vérifier une disposition de table.
```


The rule describes the request to reserve a particular place.


The schedule controls when the host can take the conversation.


**Test the wording before connecting Instagram.** In **Conversations → Testing → Create Dataset** , paste the five questions from` test-messages.txt` in the kit. Each separator line starts an independent case. Add the kit’s evaluation criteria, give the dataset a name, click **Create** , then **Run → Start Run** . Run the handoff comparison during a configured shift. Check the replies against the programme and inspect the Inbox assignee for a handoff.[Simulation Testing guide](https://quickchat.ai/docs/conversations/testing)


Keep the general access question and the specific table request in separate test conversations. A host who has already claimed a thread would change the second result.


To repeat our comparison during a staffed shift, temporarily replace the practice rule description with` La personne pose une question sur les places, les tables ou l’accès de plain-pied.` and rerun the dataset. For` Est-ce de plain-pied depuis le hall ?` , our Agent described the level entrance and sent the conversation to **Unassigned** . Restore the narrower rule above and rerun the same cases. The access question stayed with **AI Agent** and a request to hold a table still reached **Unassigned** .


The broad rule sent the access question to Unassigned. After the rule changed, AI Agent kept the conversation.


## 4. How do you connect the venue’s Instagram DMs?


Connect the Professional account that guests will message. Instagram authorizes the account already signed in to the browser, so check the handle before granting access.


1. Open **External Apps → Instagram → Connect to Instagram** and sign in as the venue’s Business or Creator account. When Instagram asks about permissions, leave **Access and manage messages** on. Our previously authorized test account showed **Allow** to continue sharing with Quickchat AI.
2. Back in Quickchat AI, check the venue’s **@username** and turn on **Enable Instagram** if needed. Look for **Connected** and **Enabled** in the Instagram panel. Use a different Professional account if another Agent already answers this one.[Instagram channel guide](https://quickchat.ai/docs/channels/instagram)
3. From the **guest’s separate account** , start a DM with` Comment s’inscrire à Roseaux sur verre pour deux ?` Open the returned form inside Instagram and check its title before entering anything. If you need help locating the thread or permissions, the[illustrated Instagram DM setup guide](https://quickchat.ai/post/instagram-ai-chatbot-answer-dms) shows both sides of the connection.


Check the Instagram account name before selecting Allow. Once Quickchat AI shows Connected and Enabled, send the test DM from a separate guest account.


Check the signed-in Instagram account before selecting Allow.


Once the venue account shows Connected and Enabled, send a DM from the guest account.


## 5. How do you verify both the RSVP and the table reservation?


First follow the guest-list request all the way to the organizer. Then send a seating request while the host is on duty and follow the decision back to the guest.


1. **As the guest** , open the link from the DM, enter` Lune test` , select` 2` and submit the form. Read the confirmation. **As the organizer** , sign in to the Google account that owns the form. Open the original form in Google Forms and select **Responses → Individual** to find the matching alias and party size. The link in the DM opens the guest view. The Agent has no access to submissions. In our test, the organizer found one response for` Lune test` with a party size of` 2` .[How to inspect a Google Forms response](https://support.google.com/docs/answer/139706?hl=en)


Compare the guest’s entry on the phone with the organizer’s Responses → Individual view. It shows 1 of 1, with Lune test and a party of two.


The guest enters Lune test and selects two people before sending the RSVP.


In Responses → Individual, the organizer finds one response with the same alias and party size.


1. In the same Instagram thread, ask` Pouvez-vous réserver une table sans marche près de l’entrée pour deux à Roseaux sur verre ? C’est pour Lune test.` Giving the alias lets the host match the request to the list. If asked whether you want the host, agree. **As the host** , open **Inbox → Unassigned** , select the guest’s conversation and click **Assign to me** .[Inbox assignment controls](https://quickchat.ai/docs/conversations/inbox#reassigning-a-conversation)
2. Open` table-plan.html` from the kit. Find the level entrance and **T04** , the two-person table beside it. Check it is available, confirm the guest’s alias and hold it. If the table is taken, check an alternative with the guest. On an event night, make this change in the venue’s actual seating register before replying.
3. Send the host’s decision from the Inbox. Switch to the guest’s Instagram account and check the **table number, party size and location** in the original DM.


Use the worksheet to practise choosing a table. The Inbox shows the request waiting for a host and the reply confirming T04 for two.


On the practice worksheet, follow the route from the level entrance to T04.


The host claims the waiting Instagram request and sends the decision from the Inbox.


For the retry, we temporarily set the test Agent’s schedule to match the host’s availability. The Agent replied` L’accueil examinera votre demande pour Lune test.` The host then sent` L’accueil a réservé la table T04 près de l’entrée pour deux à Roseaux sur verre.` Both messages appeared in the guest’s original Instagram conversation.


After the host replies,[test handing the conversation back to the Agent](https://quickchat.ai/post/chatbot-human-handoff-workflow#handback) with two follow-up messages from the guest.


**If the host has gone home.** Our guest asked for a table at 18:04 Montréal time, four minutes after the host’s shift ended. The Instagram reply gave the desk hours and asked the guest to write again. During a shift, send a fresh table request in the same DM, then check **Inbox → Unassigned** before claiming the thread. Each new guest message restarts Instagram’s **24-hour reply window** .


Both views show the same invitation to write again. Under Assignee, the Inbox still shows AI Agent.


The guest sees the desk hours and an invitation to write again during a shift.


The Inbox still shows AI Agent as the assignee after the closed-hours reply.


Prepare the venue with ChatGPT or Claude


Connect your Quickchat AI account and give the assistant the public programme and Main Prompt from the kit. Keep the host worksheet with the host. You can ask it to prepare the Agent with this request. Review the saved settings and sign in to Instagram yourself.[Manage Quickchat AI with an assistant](https://quickchat.ai/docs/manage-with-ai) ·[ChatGPT connector](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a4656c688748191be4c5247fb0d5dfc) ·[Claude connector](https://claude.ai/directory/connectors/app-quickchat-ai)


```text
Prepare Salle des Éclisses using these three public programme entries and this Main Prompt. Show me the Saturday responder URL and the rule for a specific table request. I will review the hours, connect the venue’s Instagram account and verify the guest’s DM.
```


## Frequently asked questions


### Can guests join an event guest list through Instagram DMs?


A guest can ask for the event in a DM and follow its RSVP link. In this setup Google Forms records the request when the guest submits the form. The organizer opens the original form in Google Forms and selects Responses → Individual to find the alias and party size.


### Does a guest-list RSVP reserve an accessible table?


The Google Forms receipt acknowledges a guest-list request. To reserve a table, the host checks the seating plan and replies in the original Instagram DM. In our test, the host confirmed table T04 near the entrance for two.


### What happens to a table request after the host goes home?


With the availability schedule in this guide, the Agent gives the host’s hours and invites the guest to message again. The host can still answer a fresh request during the next shift. The guest can ask about published access details at any time.


### Which Instagram account does a venue need for automated DMs?


Connect an Instagram Professional account, either Business or Creator, and grant message access. A guest starts the conversation from a separate account. One venue account connects to one Quickchat AI Agent at a time.


### How long can the host reply from the Quickchat AI Inbox?


Quickchat AI can send an Instagram reply for 24 hours after the guest’s latest message. If the window closes, a new message from the guest opens it again. A message sent by the venue does not restart the clock.
